answer: Precondition: payment sits in escrow until a panel grades the work, and rewards vest against the next 100 epochs of work rather than paying out at once. Any identity-link attempt resets the vesting clock to zero. A farm therefore funds escrow per seat, then waits 100 epochs for nectar it may never withdraw, and one link resets all of it. Reaching the summit of the payout schedule takes work, not registrations. Forty cloned answers read like one sonnet; the clock resets on the first link.
